title: c4-brief — the judgement layer of a programme, as typed claims that expire
description: What an agent (or a person) asserts about where the programme stands: one thesis, the risks, what needs a decision, how each invariant is guarded, notes. Every claim names its subject (`about`), cites evidence that must resolve, and carries provenance stamped by Forma (`writtenAt`, `evidenceHash`, `author.engine`) — never by the fill. A claim is rendered with a colour only while an independent counter-verifier of a DIFFERENT engine than the author holds it and its evidence has not moved; otherwise it is shown grey and says so, even when `verified.verdict` is `holds`. Missing `author.engine` or `verified.engine` (legacy briefs) counts as unknown, never as a match. Written only by `forma audit --apply`; the reader's trust is the whole product.

author.description: The engine that wrote this claim's current text, stamped by Forma from the `--engine` invoking the apply that created or rewrote it; never supplied by the fill. Absent on legacy claims — that counts as unknown, not a match.

kind.description: thesis: where we stand, in one sentence (at most one). risk: what could sink it, with first-hand evidence (at most 5). decide: what only a human can settle now (at most 5). invariant: how a declared invariant is guarded. note: anything else worth keeping, no colour.

severity.description: Only meaningful for risk and invariant; a decide has no severity, it has a question.

about.description: The subject the claim is about — what makes it go stale when it changes. Exactly one key.

class.description: invariant only: a test/gate goes red when it breaks (MECCANIZZATO), it is written down and nothing checks it (DOCUMENTATO), or neither (SCOPERTO).

ifBroken.description: invariant only: what falls if it falls. An invariant without a declared consequence is an opinion.

writtenAt.description: Manifest day on which Forma accepted the claim; never supplied by the fill.

staleAfterDays.description: Overrides the manifest's staleAfterDays for this claim.

verified.description: The independent counter-verifier's last verdict on this claim, stamped by Forma at apply. Colour is granted only on a fresh `holds` from an `engine` that differs from the claim's `author.engine` (both known); a same-engine or engine-less `holds` is recorded here but rendered as not independently verified.

engine.description: The verifying engine, stamped by Forma from the `--engine` invoking the counter apply. Absent on legacy verdicts — that counts as unknown, not a match.
